entries.en: at this hour; now, at the present time
fine estameña; a fine grade of coarse woollen cloth
entries.notes: L 连写「Esta mena」当为 estameña（粗毛呢）分写，据 H「褐」及下条 lanilla 推定。
M 栏文字标[疑:x/l]，字形待核；L 之 lanilla 与 H「毛縷」相合，义可定而形有疑。

entries.zh: 止血，使血止住；脂膏（汉字栏义）
entries.en: to staunch blood, to stop bleeding; fat, grease (per the Chinese column)
entries.notes: L 残作 Esta[疑:n/m]ar la sangre，当读 estancar（止血）；H「脂」为油脂义，与 L 不合，四栏不能互证。

entries.en: tinware; tin vessels such as plates and bowls
pond, pool; river water (per the Chinese column)
entries.notes: H「河水」与 L「池塘」不完全对应，或指引水之池；H、M 自相符合而 L 义稍偏。

entries.zh: 书架，放古书旧书的架子

entries.en: to be at, to be in (a place); to be located
entries.notes: R 栏仅「nou.」，与「在」之官话对音不合，疑残误；据 L、H 及 M 首读定「在」。

entries.en: place; to be situated, to be at
to exist, to remain; to be present
entries.notes: H「存」为存在、存留义，与 L「在某处」略偏，故降等。
